apiBoundary: src/services/api.ts — all backend calls go through this module; no inline fetch/HTTP in components

build.UNIT_TEST: MANUAL: no test runner configured yet — CLAUDE.md plans Vitest + React Testing Library; until then verify with TYPECHECK + LINT and a manual dev-server check

researchLayers.name: components
researchLayers.targets: src/components/, composition, props contracts, Tailwind usage

researchLayers.name: state
researchLayers.targets: src/contexts/, custom hooks, URL-driven state, window events (cartUpdated, authChanged, authExpired)

researchLayers.name: api-types
researchLayers.targets: src/services/api.ts methods, src/types/index.ts shapes, OCC contracts, auth/cart lifecycle

manualVerificationSurfaces: Dev server route — npm run dev, then the specific path the change affects
Responsive check — mobile and desktop widths, plus dark-mode variant if the app has one
Browser console + network tab — no errors, and the expected request/response shape
Loading and error states — exercise both, not just the happy path
sliceExample: Slice 1: types + api method in the apiBoundary (TYPECHECK, LINT). Slice 2: the component consuming it, with loading + error states wired (TYPECHECK, LINT, BUILD). Slice 3: the route/page it lands on plus its e2e spec (BUILD, E2E_TEST).
triggerVocabulary: components, pages, routing, hooks, contexts, state, API client, styling, storefront, OCC API client, cart, checkout
_notes: The repo's CLAUDE.md is authoritative: functional components + named exports, components under the line limit, all backend calls through src/services/api.ts, typed responses from src/types/index.ts, loading + error states, showToast() feedback, Tailwind ordering with dark: variants.
Backend for manual verification: SAP Commerce at VITE_API_URL (default https://localhost:9002, self-signed); vite dev server proxies /occ and /authorizationserver.
When a test runner lands, replace UNIT_TEST with 'npx vitest run' and add it to the ts|tsx mapping.
Set jira.mode to 'mcp' if the Atlassian MCP connector is available in your Claude Code session.
